summary: Kilo's AI Gateway allows unauthenticated access to models tagged :free, limited to 200 requests per hour per IP. Availability rotates; check the live catalog for current free IDs. NVIDIA free endpoints are trial-only: do not submit personal or confidential data, and usage is logged for security and to improve NVIDIA products and services. Zero pricing is not a blanket production-use or privacy waiver.
claim_steps: Check https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway/models for a currently available :free model and its pricing, capabilities and provider terms; availability and model IDs can change.

For NVIDIA free endpoints, use them only for trials and never submit personal or confidential data. Usage is logged for security and to improve NVIDIA products and services; zero pricing does not waive provider usage or data restrictions.
Call the gateway without an Authorization header, or use a Kilo API key if preferred.
Stay within the 200 requests per hour per IP anonymous limit.

social_proof.title: Authentication
social_proof.text: The gateway allows unauthenticated access for free models only. Anonymous requests are identified by IP address and are subject to rate limiting (200 requests per hour per IP).

social_proof.title: Models & Providers
social_proof.text: Availability changes; check the live model catalog for current free options and model IDs. For NVIDIA free endpoints (Super/Ultra/etc): Trial use only - do not submit personal or confidential data. Your use is logged for security purposes and to improve NVIDIA products and services.
